title: Nicchavitthi-aticārini
text: 1 Idhāham āvuso Gijjhakuṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ nicchaviṃ itthiṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantiṃ || tam enaṃ gijjhā pi dhaṅkā pi kulalā pi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitacchenti vibhajenti || || Sāsudaṃ aṭṭassaraṃ karoti || || 2 Esā bhikkhave itthi imasmiññeva Rājagahe aticārinī ahosi || || Tatiyaṃ || || [page 260] 260 LAKKHAṆA-SAṂYUTTA [XIX. 14. 1
